        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n  \n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  if (\n    request.nextUrl.pathname !== \"/\" &amp;&amp;\n    !user &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/login\") &amp;&amp;\n    !request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith(\"/auth\")\n  ) {\n    // no user, potentially respond by redirecting the user to the login page\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "### &#96;auth.jwt()&#96;\n\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; column or the &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\n\n- &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &#96;supabase.auth.update()&#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\n- &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\n\nThe &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; function is extremely versatile. For example, if you store some team data inside &#96;app_metadata&#96;, you can use it to determine whether a particular user belongs to a team. For example, if this was an array of IDs:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"User is in team\"\non my_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( team_id in (select auth.jwt() -&gt; 'app_metadata' -&gt; 'teams'));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### MFA\n\nThe &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; function can be used to check for [Multi-Factor Authentication](mdc:docs/guides/auth/auth-mfa#enforce-rules-for-mfa-logins). For example, you could restrict a user from updating their profile unless they have at least 2 levels of authentication (Assurance Level 2):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Restrict updates.\"\non profiles\nas restrictive\nfor update\nto authenticated using (\n  (select auth.jwt()-&gt;&gt;'aal') = 'aal2'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## RLS performance recommendations\n\nEvery authorization system has an impact on performance. While row level security is powerful, the performance impact is important to keep in mind. This is especially true for queries that scan every row in a table - like many &#96;select&#96; operations, including those using limit, offset, and ordering.\n\nBased on a series of [tests](mdc:https:/github.com/GaryAustin1/RLS-Performance), we have a few recommendations for RLS:\n\n### Add indexes\n\nMake sure you've added [indexes](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/indexes) on any columns used within the Policies which are not already indexed (or primary keys).         "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can add an index like:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate index userid\non test_table\nusing btree (user_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Call functions with &#96;select&#96;\n\nYou can use &#96;select&#96; statement to improve policies that use functions. For example, instead of this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( auth.uid() = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nYou can do:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = user_id );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis method works well for JWT functions like &#96;auth.uid()&#96; and &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; as well as &#96;security definer&#96; Functions. Wrapping the function causes an &#96;initPlan&#96; to be run by the Postgres optimizer, which allows it to \"cache\" the results per-statement, rather than calling the function on each row.\n\nCaution: You can only use this technique if the results of the query or function do not change based on the row data.\n\n### Minimize joins\n\nYou can often rewrite your Policies to avoid joins between the source and the target table. Instead, try to organize your policy to fetch all the relevant data from the target table into an array or set, then you can use an &#96;IN&#96; or &#96;ANY&#96; operation in your filter.\n\nFor example, this is an example of a slow policy which joins the source &#96;test_table&#96; to the target &#96;team_user&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  (select auth.uid()) in (\n    select user_id\n    from team_user\n    where team_user.team_id = team_id -- joins to the source \"test_table.team_id\"\n  )\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWe can rewrite this to avoid this join, and instead select the filter criteria into a set:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access records belonging to their teams\" on test_table\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  team_id in (\n    select team_id\n    from team_user",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useState, useEffect } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { GoogleLoginButton } from \"@/components/google-login-button\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";\n\n/**\n * Test page for verifying auth restrictions\n * Tests:\n * - Google OAuth signup (should work)\n * - Email/password signup (should be blocked)\n * - OTP email signup (should be blocked)\n * - Email identity addition (should validate CZU domain)\n */\nexport default function AuthTestPage() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState&lt;{\n    emailPassword?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n    emailOTP?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n    emailIdentity?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n  }&gt;({});\n\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    checkUser();\n    supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(() =&gt; {\n      checkUser();\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  const checkUser = async () =&gt; {\n    const {\n      data: { user: currentUser },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    setUser(currentUser);\n    setLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  const testEmailPasswordSignup = async (e: React.FormEvent&lt;HTMLFormElement&gt;)\n;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "3. **&#96;teams&#96;** - Team information\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Role enum for profiles\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  color text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\n  user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n\n-- Indexes for common queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐",
        "signatures": {},

          {

          },
          {

            "text": "create table public.profiles (",

        "contents": "- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer)\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

        "contents": "---\ndescription: Guidelines for writing Postgres Row Level Security policies\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Database: Create RLS policies\n\nYou're a Supabase Postgres expert in writing row level security policies. Your purpose is to generate a policy with the constraints given by the user. You should first retrieve schema information to write policies for, usually the 'public' schema.\n\nThe output should use the following instructions:\n\n- The generated SQL must be valid SQL.\n- You can use only CREATE POLICY or ALTER POLICY queries, no other queries are allowed.\n- Always use double apostrophe in SQL strings (eg. 'Night''s watch')\n- You can add short explanations to your messages.\n- The result should be a valid markdown. The SQL code should be wrapped in &#96;&#96;&#96; (including sql language tag).\n- Always use \"auth.uid()\" instead of \"current_user\".\n- SELECT policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK\n- INSERT policies should always have WITH CHECK but not USING\n- UPDATE policies should always have WITH CHECK and most often have USING\n- DELETE policies should always have USING but not WITH CHECK\n- Don't use &#96;FOR ALL&#96;. Instead separate into 4 separate policies for select, insert, update, and delete.\n- The policy name should be short but detailed text explaining the policy, enclosed in double quotes.\n- Always put explanations as separate text. Never use inline SQL comments.\n- If the user asks for something that's not related to SQL policies, explain to the user\n  that you can only help with policies.\n- Discourage &#96;RESTRICTIVE&#96; policies and encourage &#96;PERMISSIVE&#96; policies, and explain why.\n\nThe output should look like this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE POLICY \"My descriptive policy.\" ON books FOR INSERT to authenticated USING ( (select auth.uid()) = author_id ) WITH ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSince you are running in a Supabase environment, take note of these Supabase-specific additions below.\n\n## Authenticated and unauthenticated roles\n\nSupabase maps every request to one of the roles:\n\n- &#96;anon&#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\n- &#96;authenticated&#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)",

        "contents": "import { EnvVarWarning } from \"@/components/env-var-warning\";\nimport { AuthButton } from \"@/components/auth-button\";\nimport { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport default async function ProtectedLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center\"&gt;\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        },
        "contents": "if (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL (profiles, teams, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (business logic) | Medium | ~80 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Admin UI (profiles + teams) | Medium | ~150 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~525 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles, teams data with RLS for row-level access control\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation, team management",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n      const redirectTo = next || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles and teams tables\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into profiles and teams tables\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features",

        "contents": "- &#96;anon&#96;: an unauthenticated request (the user is not logged in)\n- &#96;authenticated&#96;: an authenticated request (the user is logged in)\n\nThese are actually [Postgres Roles](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/roles). You can use these roles within your Policies using the &#96;TO&#96; clause:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles are viewable by everyone\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated, anon\nusing ( true );\n\n-- OR\n\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nNote that &#96;for ...&#96; must be added after the table but before the roles. &#96;to ...&#96; must be added after &#96;for ...&#96;:\n\n### Incorrect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nto authenticated\nfor select\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Correct\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"\non profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Multiple operations\n\nPostgreSQL policies do not support specifying multiple operations in a single FOR clause. You need to create separate policies for each operation.\n\n### Incorrect\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be created and deleted by any user\"\non profiles\nfor insert, delete -- cannot create a policy on multiple operators\nto authenticated\nwith check ( true )\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Correct\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be created by any user\"\non profiles\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( true );\n\ncreate policy \"Profiles can be deleted by any user\"\non profiles\nfor delete\nto authenticated\nusing ( true );\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Helper functions\n\nSupabase provides some helper functions that make it easier to write Policies.\n\n### &#96;auth.uid()&#96;\n\nReturns the ID of the user making the request.\n\n### &#96;auth.jwt()&#96;\n\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; column or the &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\n\n- &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &#96;supabase.auth.update()&#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.",

            "text": "using ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "Note that &#96;for ...&#96; must be added after the table but before the roles. &#96;to ...&#96; must be added after &#96;for ...&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "### Incorrect",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "on profiles",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "for select",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "### Correct",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Public profiles are viewable only by authenticated users\"",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "on profiles",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "for select",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "## Multiple operations",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "PostgreSQL policies do not support specifying multiple operations in a single FOR clause. You need to create separate policies for each operation.",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "### Incorrect",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Profiles can be created and deleted by any user\"",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "on profiles",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "for insert, delete -- cannot create a policy on multiple operators",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "with check ( true )",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "### Correct",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 100
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Profiles can be created by any user\"",
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "on profiles",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "text": "for insert",
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "with check ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 106
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107
          },
          {
            "text": "create policy \"Profiles can be deleted by any user\"",
            "lineNumber": 108
          },
          {
            "text": "on profiles",
            "lineNumber": 109
          },
          {
            "text": "for delete",
            "lineNumber": 110
          },
          {
            "text": "to authenticated",
            "lineNumber": 111
          },
          {
            "text": "using ( true );",
            "lineNumber": 112
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114
          },
          {
            "text": "## Helper functions",
            "lineNumber": 115
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116
          },
          {
            "text": "Supabase provides some helper functions that make it easier to write Policies.",
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;auth.uid()&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "Returns the ID of the user making the request.",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "### &#96;auth.jwt()&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "Returns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; column or the &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &#96;supabase.auth.update()&#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.",
            "lineNumber": 127
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nThree tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User profile data with role and team membership\n3. **&#96;teams&#96;** - Team information\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "export default function AuthTestPage() {\nconst testEmailOTPSignup = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  const testEmailIdentityAddition = async (\n    e: React.FormEvent&lt;HTMLFormElement&gt;\n  ) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);\n    const email = formData.get(\"email\") as string;\n\n    if (!user) {\n      setTestResults((prev) =&gt; ({\n        ...prev,\n        emailIdentity: {\n          success: false,\n          message: \"You must be logged in to test email identity addition\",\n        },\n      }));\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({\n        email: email.trim(),\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        setTestResults((prev) =&gt; ({\n          ...prev,\n          emailIdentity: {\n            success: false,\n            message: error.message || \"Failed to add email identity\",\n          },\n        }));\n      } else {\n        setTestResults((prev) =&gt; ({\n          ...prev,\n          emailIdentity: {\n            success: true,\n            message: \"Email identity update initiated (check email for OTP)\",\n          },\n        }));\n      }\n    } catch (err: any) {\n      setTestResults((prev) =&gt; ({\n        ...prev,\n        emailIdentity: {\n          success: false,\n          message: err.message || \"Unexpected error\",\n        },\n      }));\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleSignOut = async () =&gt; {\n    await supabase.auth.signOut();\n    setUser(null);\n    setTestResults({});\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center\"&gt;\n        &lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"container mx-auto max-w-4xl p-6 space-y-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Restrict signups to Google OAuth only\n-- Purpose: Blocks email/password signups and OTP signups, only allows Google OAuth\n-- This ensures all new accounts must be created via Google OAuth\n\n-- Create before_user_created hook in public schema to only allow Google OAuth signups\n-- Blocks email/password signups and other OAuth providers\n-- Uses public schema instead of auth schema\ncreate or replace function public.before_user_created_hook(event jsonb)\nreturns jsonb\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_provider text;\n  v_encrypted_password text;\n  v_app_metadata jsonb;\n  v_identity jsonb;\n  v_has_google_identity boolean := false;\nbegin\n  -- Extract encrypted_password first (most reliable indicator of password signup)\n  v_encrypted_password := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;&gt;'encrypted_password';\n  \n  -- Block password-based signups immediately (they have encrypted_password)\n  if v_encrypted_password is not null then\n    raise exception 'Password-based signups are not allowed. Please use Google OAuth to sign in.';\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Extract provider from multiple possible locations\n  -- 1. raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'provider'\n  v_provider := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'raw_user_meta_data'-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  \n  -- 2. app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider'\n  v_app_metadata := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata';\n  if v_provider is null and v_app_metadata is not null then\n    v_provider := v_app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  end if;\n  \n  -- 3. Check identities array for Google provider (most reliable for OAuth)\n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities' is not null then\n    for v_identity in \n      select value from jsonb_array_elements(event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities')\n    loop\n      if v_identity-&gt;&gt;'provider' = 'google' then\n        v_has_google_identity := true;\n        exit;\n      end if;\n    end loop;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Allow Google OAuth signups (check both provider variable and identities array)\n  if v_provider = 'google' or v_has_google_identity then\n    return event;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- If we reach here, it's not a Google OAuth signup and not a password signup\n  -- This must be an OTP or other email-based signup attempt",

        "contents": "SECURITY DEFINER\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM realtime.send(\n    'room:' || NEW.room_id::text,\n    'status_changed',\n    jsonb_build_object('id', NEW.id, 'status', NEW.status),\n    false\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nThis allows us to broadcast to a specific room with any content that is not bound to a table or if you need to send data to public channels. It's also a good way to integrate with other services and extensions.\n\n### Conditional Broadcasting\nIf you need to broadcast only significant changes, you can use the following pattern:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Only broadcast significant changes\nIF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN\n  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(\n    'room:' || NEW.room_id::text,\n    TG_OP,\n    TG_OP,\n    TG_TABLE_NAME,\n    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,\n    NEW,\n    OLD\n  );\nEND IF;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nThis is just an example as you can use any logic you want that is SQL compatible.\n\n## Authorization Setup\n\n### Basic RLS Setup\nTo access a private channel you need to set RLS policies against &#96;realtime.messages&#96; table for SELECT operations.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Simple policy with indexed columns\nCREATE POLICY \"room_members_can_read\" ON realtime.messages\nFOR SELECT TO authenticated\nUSING (\n  topic LIKE 'room:%' AND\n  EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM room_members\n    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    AND room_id = SPLIT_PART(topic, ':', 2)::uuid\n  )\n);\n\n-- Required index for performance\nCREATE INDEX idx_room_members_user_room\nON room_members(user_id, room_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nTo write to a private channel you need to set RLS policies against &#96;realtime.messages&#96; table for INSERT operations.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Simple policy with indexed columns\nCREATE POLICY \"room_members_can_write\" ON realtime.messages\nFOR INSERT TO authenticated\nUSING (\n  topic LIKE 'room:%' AND\n  EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM room_members\n    WHERE user_id = auth.uid()\n    AND room_id = SPLIT_PART(topic, ':', 2)::uuid\n  )\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Client Authorization\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst channel = supabase.channel('room:123:messages', {\n  config: { private: true }\n})\n  .on('broadcast', { event: 'message_created' }, handleMessage)",

                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"create table public.user_profiles (\\\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\\\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\\\\n  verified_work_email text unique,\\\\n  google_email text,\\\\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\\\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\\\\n);\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\\\\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\\\\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\\\\n  'pef.czu.cz',\\\\n] as const;\\\\n\\\\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\\\\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\\\\n};\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\\\\n\\\\nUpdate [&amp;amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96 [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 6865,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"        \\\"contents\\\": \\\"create table public.user_profiles (\\\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\\\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\\\\n  verified_work_email text unique,\\\\n  google_email text,\\\\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\\\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\\\\n);\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\\\\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\\\\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\\\\n  'pef.czu.cz',\\\\n] as const;\\\\n\\\\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&amp;amp;gt; {\\\\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\\\\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\\\\n};\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96;\\\\n\\\\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\\\\n\\\\nUpdate [&amp;amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\\\n\\\\n&amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;#96 [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7338,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7510,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 7539,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"1. **&amp;#96;users&amp;#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8126,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &amp;#96;updated_at&amp;#96; column on every update.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;sql\\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\\ncreate table public.users (\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\n  email text not null,\\n  name text,\\n  picture text,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text unique no [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8141,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8153,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8296,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8771,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8860,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 8941,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9013,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- Delegation to business logic services\\n- Logging and observability\\n\\n**Business Logic** (in service layer):\\n- Core business rules and validations\\n- Domain-specific operations\\n- Data transformations and calculations\\n- Business workflow orchestration\\n- Domain knowledge and expertise\\n\\n**Example:**\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Application Logic (tRPC Procedure)\\nexport const createUserProcedure = protectedProcedure\\n  .input(createUserSchema)\\n  .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // Application logic: validation, auth, delegation\\n      const result = await createUser({\\n        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\\n        ...input\\n      });\\n      \\n      return { success: true, data: result };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      // Application logic: error handling\\n      if (error instanceof CustomError) {\\n        throw error;\\n      }\\n      throw new CustomError(\\\"INTERNAL_ERROR\\\", \\\"An unexpected error occurred\\\");\\n    }\\n  });\\n\\n// Busin [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9094,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9905,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"/**\\n * Creates a new feature item for the authenticated user\\n * Validates input, delegates to business logic, and handles errors\\n */\\nexport const actionProcedure = protectedProcedure\\n  .input(inputSchema)\\n  .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const result = await performFeatureAction({\\n        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\\n        ...input\\n      });\\n      \\n      return { success: true, data: result };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      if (error instanceof CustomError) {\\n        throw error;\\n      }\\n      throw new CustomError(\\\"INTERNAL_ERROR\\\", \\\"An unexpected error occurred\\\");\\n    }\\n  });\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### tRPC Router Template\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// src/server/api/routers/[feature].ts\\nimport { createTRPCRouter } from \\\"../trpc\\\";\\nimport { actionProcedure } from \\\"../procedures/[feature]\\\";\\n\\nexport const featureRouter = createTRPCRouter({\\n  action: actionProcedure,\\n});\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Custom Error Templa [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 9945,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 11651,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexity\\n\\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\\n\\n|------|------------|---------------|\\n\\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\\n\\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\\n\\n| Database [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 11697,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Query database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13320,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexity\\n\\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\\n\\n|------|------------|---------------|\\n\\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\\n\\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\\n\\n| Database [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 15908,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- Delegation to business logic services\\n- Logging and observability\\n\\n**Business Logic** (in service layer):\\n- Core business rules and validations\\n- Domain-specific operations\\n- Data transformations and calculations\\n- Business workflow orchestration\\n- Domain knowledge and expertise\\n\\n**Example:**\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Application Logic (tRPC Procedure)\\nexport const createUserProcedure = protectedProcedure\\n  .input(createUserSchema)\\n  .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // Application logic: validation, auth, delegation\\n      const result = await createUser({\\n        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\\n        ...input\\n      });\\n      \\n      return { success: true, data: result };\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      // Application logic: error handling\\n      if (error instanceof CustomError) {\\n        throw error;\\n      }\\n      throw new CustomError(\\\"INTERNAL_ERROR\\\", \\\"An unexpected error occurred\\\");\\n    }\\n  });\\n\\n// Busin [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 15989,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 21066,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 23881,

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Supabase Configuration Changes\\n\\nUpdate [&amp;#96;supabase/config.toml&amp;#96;](supabase/config.toml):\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;toml\\n[auth]\\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\\n\\n[auth.email]\\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\\n\\n[auth.external.google]\\nenabled = true\\nclient_id = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\\\"\\nsecret = \\\"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\\\"\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps [... omitted end of long line]"

                },

                  "lineNumber": 35518,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 6407,
                  "content": "  \"result\": \"{\\\"content\\\":[{\\\"type\\\":\\\"text\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"searchDocs\\\\\\\":{\\\\\\\"nodes\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"title\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"Identity Linking\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"href\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/auth-identity-linking\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"# Identity Linking\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nManage the identities associated with your user\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Identity linking strategies\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nCurrently, Supabase Auth supports 2 strategies to link an identity to a user:\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n1.  [Automatic Linking](#automatic-linking)\\\\\\\\n2.  [Manual Linking](#manual-linking-beta)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n### Automatic linking\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nSupabase Auth automatically links identities with the same email address to a single user. This helps to improve the user experience when multiple OAuth login options are presented since the user does not need to remember which OAuth account they used to sign up with. When a new user signs in with OAuth, Supabase Auth will attempt to look for an existing user that uses the same email address. If a match is found, t [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 6487,
                  "content": "  \"result\": \"{\\\"content\\\":[{\\\"type\\\":\\\"text\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"searchDocs\\\\\\\":{\\\\\\\"nodes\\\\\\\":[{\\\\\\\"title\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"Anonymous Sign-Ins\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"href\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"https://supabase.com/docs/guides/auth/auth-anonymous\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"content\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"# Anonymous Sign-Ins\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nCreate and use anonymous users to authenticate with Supabase\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n[Enable Anonymous Sign-Ins](/dashboard/project/_/auth/providers) to build apps which provide users an authenticated experience without requiring users to enter an email address, password, use an OAuth provider or provide any other PII (Personally Identifiable Information). Later, when ready, the user can link an authentication method to their account.\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&amp;lt;Admonition type=\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"note\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\" label=\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"Anonymous user vs the anon key\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"&amp;gt;\\\\\\\\n  Calling &amp;#96;signInAnonymously()&amp;#96; creates an anonymous user. It's just like a permanent user, except the user can't access their account if they sign out, clear browsing data, or use another device.\\\\ [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 6520,
                  "content": "      \"parameters\": \"{\\\"query\\\":\\\"\\\\n-- Check current identities for both users\\\\nSELECT \\\\n  u.id as user_id,\\\\n  u.email,\\\\n  u.raw_user_meta_data-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'provider' as primary_provider,\\\\n  i.id as identity_id,\\\\n  i.provider,\\\\n  i.identity_data-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'email' as identity_email\\\\nFROM auth.users u\\\\nLEFT JOIN auth.identities i ON u.id = i.user_id\\\\nWHERE u.id IN ('5aa9f286-d59b-4bb0-9a35-9f3e380af015', 'e6742972-eedf-4234-8e16-54c975352fa1')\\\\nORDER BY u.created_at, i.created_at;\\\\n\\\"}\","

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; is linked   |\\n\\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\\n\\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\\n\\n| Access without pre-created profile          | Profile must exist before linking (admin creates profiles)           |\\n\\n| Revoked access                              | Middleware checks &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;           |\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps all business logic  [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3144,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3233,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3290,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"if (!profile) {\\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\\n}\\n\\n// Link profile to current user\\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\nawait supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexit [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 3363,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"Query database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 4034,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 10437,
                  "content": "      \"parameters\": \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"auth_tables\\\",\\\"query\\\":\\\"-- Role enum for profiles\\\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\\\n\\\\n-- Teams table\\\\ncreate table public.teams (\\\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\\\n  name text not null,\\\\n  picture text,\\\\n  color text,\\\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\\\n  name text not null,\\\\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\\\\n  user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\\\n  phone_number text,\\\\n  personal_email tex [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 10862,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"                  \\\"content\\\": \\\"        \\\\\\\"contents\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"create table public.user_profiles (\\\\\\\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\\\\\\\n  role text not null default 'user' check (role in ('user', 'admin')),\\\\\\\\n  verified_work_email text unique,\\\\\\\\n  google_email text,\\\\\\\\n  created_at timestamptz default now(),\\\\\\\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now()\\\\\\\\n);\\\\\\\\n&amp;amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n## Allowed Domains (Hardcoded Constants)\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n&amp;amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;amp;#96;typescript\\\\\\\\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\\\\\\\\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\\\\\\\\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\\\\\\\\n  'pef.czu.cz',\\\\\\\\n] as const;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&amp;amp;amp;gt; {\\\\\\\\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\\\\\\\\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\\\\\\\\n};\\\\\\\\n&amp;amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;amp;#96;&amp;amp;amp;#96;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n# [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 12888,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; is linked   |\\n\\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\\n\\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\\n\\n| Access without pre-created profile          | Profile must exist before linking (admin creates profiles)           |\\n\\n| Revoked access                              | Middleware checks &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;           |\\n\\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\\n\\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\\n\\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.user_id&amp;#96; matches current auth.user.id\\n- **Access Active**: Check &amp;#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96;\\n- **User Role**: Read &amp;#96;profiles.role&amp;#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\\n\\nThis approach:\\n\\n- Keeps all business logic  [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "lineNumber": 12941,

                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13030,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 13087,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"## Architecture Overview\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;mermaid\\nflowchart TD\\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&amp;gt; B[Google OAuth]\\n        B --&amp;gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\\n        C --&amp;gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\\n        D --&amp;gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\\n        E --&amp;gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\\n        F --&amp;gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\\n        G --&amp;gt; E\\n        F --&amp;gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\\n        H --&amp;gt; I[User enters OTP]\\n        I --&amp;gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\\n        J --&amp;gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\\n        J --&amp;gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\\n        D --&amp;gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\\n        L --&amp;gt; M\\n        M --&amp;gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\\n        M --&amp;gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\\n    end\\n\\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\\n        P[Incoming Request] --&amp;gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\\n        Q --&amp;gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\\n    [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 13343,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Role enum for profiles\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Teams table\\ncreate table public.teams (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  color text,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\\n  user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,  --  [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "lineNumber": 15702,

                  "lineNumber": 15906,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"if (!profile) {\\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\\n}\\n\\n// Link profile to current user\\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\nawait supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexit [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "content": "      \"parameters\": \"{\\\"query\\\":\\\"-- Check what users exist in auth.users\\\\nSELECT \\\\n  id,\\\\n  email,\\\\n  created_at,\\\\n  email_confirmed_at\\\\nFROM auth.users\\\\nLIMIT 10;\\\"}\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17291,
                  "content": "      \"parameters\": \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"add_users_table\\\",\\\"query\\\":\\\"-- Users table to track authenticated users (including unverified ones)\\\\n-- This table syncs with auth.users and tracks verification status\\\\ncreate table public.users (\\\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\\\n  email text not null,\\\\n  name text,\\\\n  picture text,\\\\n  profile_id uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\\\n);\\\\n\\\\n-- Index for common queries\\\\ncreate index users_profile_id_idx on public.users(profile_id);\\\\ncreate index users_email_idx on public.users(email);\\\\n\\\\n-- Enable RLS\\\\nalter table public.users enable row level security;\\\\n\\\\n-- RLS Policies for users\\\\n-- Users can view their own record\\\\ncreate policy \\\\\\\"Users can view their own record\\\\\\\"\\\\n  on public.users for select\\\\n  using (id = auth.uid());\\\\n\\\\n-- Admins can view all users\\\\ncreate policy \\\\ [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 17331,
                  "content": "      \"parameters\": \"{\\\"query\\\":\\\"-- Sync existing auth.users to public.users\\\\nINSERT INTO public.users (id, email, name, picture)\\\\nSELECT \\\\n  id,\\\\n  email,\\\\n  coalesce(raw_user_meta_data-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'full_name', raw_user_meta_data-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'name') as name,\\\\n  raw_user_meta_data-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'avatar_url' as picture\\\\nFROM auth.users\\\\nON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE\\\\nSET\\\\n  email = excluded.email,\\\\n  name = coalesce(excluded.name, public.users.name),\\\\n  picture = coalesce(excluded.picture, public.users.picture),\\\\n  updated_at = now();\\\"}\","

                  "lineNumber": 32344,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"if (!profile) {\\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\\n}\\n\\n// Link profile to current user\\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\nawait supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .update({ \\n    user_id: user.id,\\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\\n  })\\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\\n\\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &amp;#96;removed_access IS NULL&amp;#96; on every request to protected routes.\\n\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;typescript\\n// Middleware check\\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\\n  .from('profiles')\\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\\n  .single();\\n\\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\\n// User has active access, continue...\\n&amp;#96;&amp;#96;&amp;#96;\\n\\n## Estimated Complexit [... omitted end of long line]"

                },

                  "lineNumber": 983,
